about: Block Party's space markers (docs/plans/block-party.md, "Space markers"). Each type's texture, stretched once over each face of the marker: any block texture of Minecraft's by its path (textures/blocks/...) or a 16 x 16 picture of your own in resource_pack/textures/blockparty/spaces/. The highlight is how a space lights up while a piece stands on it or a cutscene shows it: drawn at full light with color laid over it, strength plus or minus pulse, once every seconds. The model is resource_pack/models/entity/space.geo.json. After changing this file or the model, run: npx tsx tools/blockparty/space-pack.ts
